verdict.rationale: Postman's navigation docs list an API Catalog and a Private API Network alongside the Public API Network. Internal workspaces let teams share, version and discuss API work, and role and permission controls govern access. Together these point to a first-party internal catalog for discovering and consuming APIs, but the evidence is mostly a navigation-menu mention with no depth on publishing or consumption workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of how to publish APIs to the Private API Network or API Catalog, team discovery and search features, portal customization or branding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
